name: writhing_stalker.live_hit_fade_retreat_mcw
description: Live hit-fade-retreat row: vulnerable midnight scene records a bounded strike burst followed by withdraw/cooling-off retreat with about 8+ tile retreat intent visible in current-build live-plan logs.

steps.label: post_load_hit_fade_retreat_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: vulnerable-midnight saved-active-stalker fixture loads to live map for the hit-fade retreat window

steps.label: audit_saved_midnight_before_hit_fade_retreat
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove expected midnight time before live writhing-stalker hit-fade window
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved turn proves local midnight before hit-fade retreat window

steps.label: audit_saved_writhing_stalker_before_hit_fade_retreat
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters metadata did not contain required live hit-fade scenario footing
steps.expected_visible_fact: one hostile stalker starts four tiles east on a passable lane with cover-route opportunity before current-build live turns advance

steps.label: toggle_safe_mode_off_before_hit_fade_retreat
steps.expected_visible_fact: safe mode is toggled off so the bounded live turn window is not consumed by warnings

steps.label: operate_native_stalker_attack_retreat_window
steps.objective: Use only the current native World owner and advertised wait/movement actions. Preserve the actual stalker attack-resolution attempt, its changing position and game time, and the retained retreat phase/waypoint; keep planner text separate from the causal attack evidence.
proof_targets: native attack-resolution receipt or exact native attack-attempt evidence
before/after stalker and player positions with game-time delta
persisted attempts_spent, lifecycle phase, and retreat waypoint
matched daylight pressure and darkness controls, loss-of-sight behavior, and save/reload continuity when advertised
source, executable, actor, receipt, witness, and cleanup binding
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen bounded waits
invariants: planner decisions do not count as attack attempts
no direct state mutation, target injection, or hidden-coordinate use
preserve the first native divergence and unaffected observations

steps.label: advance_hit_fade_retreat_window
steps.expected_visible_fact: long bounded live turn window records at least two strikes followed by current-build retreat/cooling-off intent rather than one-hit flee or endless melee spam

steps.label: audit_writhing_stalker_hit_fade_retreat_live_plan
steps.abort_reason: same-run artifact lacked the current-build strike/burst/cooling-off retreat-distance live-plan sequence
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run debug artifact proves two-strike burst accounting and about-eight-tile withdraw/retreat intent after the burst limit

steps.label: confirm_native_process_replacement_after_stalker_save
steps.objective: Use the advertised native save-and-quit path, then the native Main-menu Quit action and its confirmation, to make the saved stalker state the replacement-process boundary.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native saved world reaches Main menu and the native Quit confirmation terminates the original process before replacement

steps.label: audit_relaunched_persisted_writhing_stalker_state
steps.abort_reason: the replacement process did not expose the exact native stalker lifecycle state serialized at the save boundary
steps.expected_visible_fact: replacement-generation saved active_monsters metadata contains the same typed stalker lifecycle state observed at the fresh save boundary

steps.label: observe_relaunched_persisted_writhing_stalker
steps.objective: Observe the replacement native world after the typed saved-state audit, without advancing gameplay or recreating the fixture.
invariants: saved metadata is not replaced by planner text

evidence_contract.claim: current-build writhing stalker uses its live monster::plan seam for bounded hit-fade rhythm: at least two close strikes in a vulnerable dark scene, burst counter reaches its limit, then cooldown/retreat intent targets about eight tiles instead of A/B hovering or endless melee spam
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for writhing-stalker hit-fade retreat behavior
evidence_contract.writeback_note: The live-plan claim remains current-run native behavior. Separately, the declared native save/Main-menu Quit boundary and replacement-generation audit must prove the exact typed stalker lifecycle state was serialized and reloaded; fixture installation is not persistence evidence.
